A proposal before a payment

Website pricing starts at $999 USD. The $89 USD monthly care offer begins in month two when included in your agreement. Your written proposal confirms deliverables, page count, revisions, timeline, payment schedule, taxes, third-party fees, ownership, cancellation and refund terms before payment.

Sending a brief

An enquiry is not a contract, a booking confirmation, or an obligation to pay. Work begins only after the scope and payment arrangement have been accepted by both sides.
